domain(person,[gracelyn,amalia]).

% If Gracelyn has talent, then she is either content or disillusioned, but not both.
axiom(s1, rule([talent(gracelyn)], xor(content(gracelyn), disillusioned(gracelyn)))).
% Gracelyn is not inspired.
axiom(s2, not(inspired(gracelyn))).
% If Gracelyn is passionate, then she is either inspired or creative (but not both).
axiom(s3, rule([passionate(gracelyn)], xor(inspired(gracelyn), creative(gracelyn)))).
% Gracelyn does not seek new challenges.
axiom(s4, not(seek_new_challenges(gracelyn))).
% For every human, either they have found their artistic voice or they have not found it, but not both.
axiom(s5, forall(var(x,person), xor(found_artistic_voice(var(x)), not(found_artistic_voice(var(x)))))).
% If Amalia is creative, then she has either found her artistic voice or is disillusioned, but not both.
axiom(s6, rule([creative(amalia)], xor(found_artistic_voice(amalia), disillusioned(amalia)))).
% If Gracelyn struggles to create, then she has either found fulfillment or is disillusioned, but not both.
axiom(s7, rule([struggles_to_create(gracelyn)], xor(found_fulfillment(gracelyn), disillusioned(gracelyn)))).
% Gracelyn does not have a clear mind.
axiom(s8, not(clear_mind(gracelyn))).
% If Gracelyn is creative, then she has either found her artistic voice or is disillusioned, but not both.
axiom(s9, rule([creative(gracelyn)], xor(found_artistic_voice(gracelyn), disillusioned(gracelyn)))).
% Gracelyn is motivated.
axiom(s10, motivated(gracelyn)).
% If Gracelyn explores options or seeks new challenges, then she can discover a new medium.
axiom(s11, rule([or(explores_options(gracelyn), seek_new_challenges(gracelyn))], discover_new_medium(gracelyn))).
% If Gracelyn is motivated, then she either finds her flow or has a clear mind, but not both.
axiom(s12, rule([motivated(gracelyn)], xor(finds_flow(gracelyn), clear_mind(gracelyn)))).
% Gracelyn struggles to create.
axiom(s13, struggles_to_create(gracelyn)).
% Gracelyn explores options.
axiom(s14, explores_options(gracelyn)).
% Gracelyn is passionate.
axiom(s15, passionate(gracelyn)).
% Anyone who discovers a new medium or finds their flow can feel fulfilled.
axiom(s16, rule([or(discover_new_medium(var(x)), finds_flow(var(x)))], feel_fulfilled(var(x)))).
